### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** An external tabulated equation of state behind the `aneos` alias: the wrapper delegates every thermodynamic map to a table provider supplied outside this tree.
**Data.** In: the cell averages of five rows, total density $\rho$ [kg m$^{-3}$] (`IDN`), the three momentum densities $m_1, m_2, m_3$ [kg m$^{-2}$ s$^{-1}$] (`IVX`, `IVY`, `IVZ`) and the total energy density $E$ [J m$^{-3}$] (`IPR`) of `hydro_u`, or $\rho$ [kg m$^{-3}$], $v_1, v_2, v_3$ [m s$^{-1}$] and $p$ [Pa] of `hydro_w`; no species row is read, so the basis is the total mass of the cell; plus the `eos-file` path. Out, in the same cells: the other representation in those five rows; the internal energy per unit volume [J m$^{-3}$] (`W->I`, `UT->I`); $T$ [K] (`W->T`); $c_s$ [m s$^{-1}$] (`W->L`); the adiabatic index $c_s^2\rho/p$ [-] (`WL->A`). The provider is asked for $(p, T, c_s)$, $(T, e\rho, c_s)$ or $(p, e\rho, c_s)$ from $(\rho, e\rho)$, $(\rho, p)$ or $(\rho, T)$; this tree computes none of those values.
**Placement.** Wherever the EOS is evaluated; the provider replaces the shipped weak symbols at link time.
**Activation.** `type: aneos` with `eos-file`; the default EOS stays `moist-mixture`.
**Guarantee / limits.** No accuracy is available from this tree: the shipped weak symbols throw, so the wrapper alone computes nothing.
**Evidence.** None: no ctest entry exercises the wrapper, and no linked implementation exists in this tree (missing evidence); the report-only `aneos_check.py` is run with its committed output `src/snapy_report/ch02/aneos_check.out`.
:::

The wrapper delegates thermodynamics to an external table provider. Its shipped weak symbols throw, so the wrapper alone supplies no material accuracy evidence. The factory alias is `aneos`.

### Derivation

No thermodynamic model is shipped to derive. The wrapper defines the effective adiabatic index from the
external sound speed, pressure and density:
$$
\gamma=c_s^2\rho/p
$$ {#eq-ch02-aneos-gamma}

@eq-ch02-aneos-gamma is implemented by `cs` in {{< code src/eos/aneos.cpp ANEOSImpl::compute >}}.
This is an interface identity, not a claim that the external material has constant heat capacity.
`aneos_check.py` prints an explicitly labelled illustration only; it provides no validation of a material table.

### Numerical method

`DU->PTL` supplies pressure, temperature and speed from density and internal energy density.
`DP->TUL` supplies temperature, internal energy and speed from density and pressure. `DT->PUL` handles
the temperature-floor request. All are cell-local external calls. No internal interpolation stencil is shipped.


### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
The shipped constructor throws. The wrapper lacks moist species and metric raising/lowering. It does not
implement `W->A`; callers must use `W->L` then `WL->A`. The base heat-capacity method returns zero.
No external ANEOS, wall, seam or forcing compatibility run is claimed.
Switch-combination coverage remains pending in @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::
